assembly_notes: Bond the traction pad to the cleaned, dry board deck using compatible adhesive and verify alignment and adhesion.
Fit and secure fins in their boxes; check retention and confirm the board has no delamination or sharp defects.
No electronics or battery are present; no burn-in or battery shipping controls are required.
